item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Portrait From a Seventies Film

turns.text: Make this look like a still from a 1970s movie—warm faded colours and film grain. Keep her recognisable and keep the square framing. No text.

item.tests: Applies a convincing 1970s film treatment while preserving the uploaded portrait's identity and composition.

answer_sheet.Style and mood: A nostalgic 1970s colour film still, with warm faded colours and visible film grain.
answer_sheet.What to preserve: Her identity, curly dark hair, sweater, pose and park setting.
answer_sheet.Size and format: One square image; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The woman remains recognisable as the woman in the source portrait.
Her curly dark hair, sweater and head-and-shoulders framing are retained.
The park background remains identifiable rather than becoming a different setting.
Warm, faded colour grading and visible film grain give the image a 1970s film-still appearance.
The output is square and contains no added text.

turns.text: make a pic from this pic

dialog.agent:
I can do that. What should the new picture look like? A few options:

- **New style:** turn it into an anime, watercolor, oil painting, Pixar-style or sketch version.
- **New background:** keep her the same but put her in a different place, like a beach, a city at night, a studio backdrop or snowy mountains.
- **Headshot:** make a polished, professional headshot.
- **Outfit or look change:** change her sweater, add accessories or try a different hairstyle.
- **No background:** cut her out of the park so the background is clear.
- **Something else:** describe it and I'll make it.

Tell me which one, plus any details like the style or setting.
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose the kind of edit and give details, then waits for the answer.
dialog.user: something else, make it look like an old 70s movie still. warm faded colours and film grain

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the picture because your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was created.

I'd already picked the cheapest option on your free plan: one 640px image with the flux-2-klein model, about 5 credits. There's no lower setting to try, so I can't make it right now.

To get it made, you can:
- **Add credits** with a credit pack or a plan upgrade on magichour.ai, or
- **Wait for your free credits to top up**, if your plan includes a refill.

Once you have credits again, tell me and I'll run it with the same look: warm amber and orange tones, faded colors, soft blacks, film grain and a slight vignette. She and the park setting will stay the same.
